description: Describe a project and get exactly the 5 best-fit agencies, each with a one-line reason. Verified agencies receive a ranking boost in this tool. Optional budget (USD) and location (city or country).

budget.description: Max budget in USD, e.g. 5000 or "$5k"

location.description: City or country the agency should be based in

project_brief.description: What needs to be built, e.g. "WhatsApp support bot for a Spanish e-commerce shop"

name: match_agencies
title: Match the best 5 agencies to a project
